name: Greater Knight's Edict buffs players but not the Shadowhound (#4733)
contract: Issue #4733: Greater Knight's Edict 523510 is a 40 yard TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID aura, so the caster's own Shadowhound (50124) satisfied the raid-target check and received the buff.

The spell is now bound to spell_ascension_witch_hunter_greater_knights_edict, which drops every non-player from the area target list. With the hound summoned, one cast must leave the Witch Hunter carrying 523510 while the Shadowhound carries none.

steps.label: Let login and class synchronisation settle
The Witch Hunter keeps the edict
